criteria.name: Accuracy of Information
criteria.feedback: Your submission is factually accurate and reliably describes technology's impact, but to earn full credit, provide specific examples or evidence to fully support your claims next time.

criteria.name: Coherence and Logical Flow
criteria.feedback: Your essay presents two related statements that show a basic logical connection, but coherence is weakened by the absence of smooth transitions or a developed argument. To improve, focus on linking your points with transitions and elaborating on the connections between your ideas.

criteria.name: Conciseness and Focus
criteria.feedback: Your essay is generally clear and concise, with focused points throughout, though there is minor repetition between the title and your first sentence; aim to avoid this in such brief formats to achieve full marks.

criteria.name: Grammar and Mechanics
criteria.feedback: Your writing is clear, polished, and free of grammar, punctuation, or spelling errors, fully meeting college-level expectations for mechanics.

criteria.name: Precision and Clarity of Language
criteria.feedback: Your language is mostly clear and unambiguous, but phrases like 'many areas' and 'digital tools' are a bit broad; adding more specific examples or naming particular technologies would make your writing even sharper.
